Om Prakash
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, learned counsel for the
petitioner. 
2. Mr. N. S. Pundir, learned DAG for the State.
3. List on 16.10.2026 in order to enable the State
Counsel to get instructions why pension is not being
paid to the petitioner particularly when he was retired
from service in November, 2025 and if there are some
issues, in such an eventuality, why Authorities are not
paying provisional pension to the petitioner.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 13.10.2026
SKS

3. Pursuant to the previous order Mr. 
Pundir, learned Dy. AG placed before this

under the caption “Pension Matter”. In the 
meantime, Mr. Pundir, learned Dy. AG may 
get further instructions in the matter.
